hook: Kirkeberg spent over a decade building the cloud infrastructure underneath Norway's sovereign wealth fund before pivoting to build its AI function from nothing, growing it into a 71-member AI Ambassador network across Oslo, London, New York, and Singapore with measured efficiency gains rather than speculative claims.
name: Stian Kirkeberg

quote.text: Leading AI transformation at Norway's sovereign wealth fund. Built enterprise AI function and team from scratch, driving AI adoption across 700+ employees in four global offices, achieving documented 20%+ efficiency gains.

quick_facts: Head of AI & ML at Norges Bank Investment Management (NBIM), which manages Norway's roughly $1.7 trillion sovereign wealth fund
Built NBIM's AI function from scratch, driving adoption across 700+ employees in four global offices with documented 20%+ efficiency gains
Built a 71-member AI Ambassador network and established a strategic partnership with Anthropic
15-year NBIM career spanning cloud migration architecture before moving into AI leadership

achievements.title: Building NBIM's AI & ML function from scratch (2023-present)
achievements.impact: Established the fund's AI strategy and architecture, growing into a dedicated leadership function driving adoption across 700+ employees with documented 20%+ efficiency gains.

achievements.title: Building the 71-member AI Ambassador network
achievements.impact: Created a structured program training staff across four global offices on Claude, agentic AI, and internal tools including a Portfolio Analyzer dashboard and Agent Mesh.

achievements.title: Establishing NBIM's strategic partnership with Anthropic
achievements.impact: Formalized a vendor relationship supporting enterprise AI deployment at one of the world's largest institutional investors.

achievements.title: 11-year run leading NBIM's Cloud Centre of Excellence
achievements.impact: Designed and executed the migration of NBIM's investment management infrastructure, handling $1.7 trillion in assets, from on-premises to AWS and Azure.
